sloka: इमाम् विरूपाम् असतीम् करालाम् निर्णत उदरीम् ।अनेन सह ते भ्रात्रा भक्षयिष्यामि मानुषीम् ॥३-१७-२७॥
transliteration: imām virūpām asatīm karālām nirṇata udarīm ।anena saha te bhrātrā bhakṣayiṣyāmi mānuṣīm ॥3-17-27॥

translations.english: She is ugly, deformed, unsuitable for you. I am alone fit for you. Look upon me as your wife.
